sentences.zh: 法興曰：「日有八行，合成一道，月有一道，離為九行，左交右疾，倍半相違，其一終之理，日數宜同。

translations.literal: Faxing said: "The sun has eight motions, forming one path together; the moon has one path, divided into nine motions; left is crossing, right is fast, double and half mutually diverge; for one cycle's principle the day-count ought to be the same.
translations.idiomatic: Dai Faxing said: "The sun has eight motions, forming one path together; the moon has one path, divided into nine motions; crossing left and fast right, double and half mutually diverge—for one complete cycle the day-count ought to be the same.

sentences.zh: 沖之通同與會周相覺九千四十，其陰陽七十九周有奇，遲疾不及一匝，此則當縮反盈，應損更益。

translations.literal: Chongzhi's communication cycle and conjunction cycle differ by nine thousand forty; his yin-yang seventy-nine cycles have a fraction, slow-fast not reaching one circuit—this means where there should be shrinkage there is instead surplus, where there should be decrease there is instead increase."
translations.idiomatic: Zu Chongzhi's communication cycle and conjunction cycle differ by 9,040; his yin-yang seventy-nine cycles have a fraction, slow-fast falling short of one circuit—this means where there should be shrinkage there is surplus, where there should be decrease there is increase."

sentences.zh: 」沖之曰：此議雖遊漫無據，然言跡可檢。

translations.literal: Chongzhi said: This objection though wandering without basis, yet its words can be tested.
translations.idiomatic: Zu Chongzhi said: This objection though wandering without basis, yet its words can be tested.

sentences.zh: 按以日八行譬月九道，此為月行之軌，當循一轍，環匝於天，理無差動也。

translations.literal: Examining comparing the sun's eight motions to the moon's nine paths—this is the moon's track; it ought to follow one rut, circling Heaven in circuits, principle allowing no discrepancy.
translations.idiomatic: Examining comparing the sun's eight motions to the moon's nine paths—this is the moon's track; it ought to follow one rut, circling Heaven in circuits, principle allowing no discrepancy.

sentences.zh: 然則交會之際，當有定所，豈容或鬥或牛，同麗一度。

translations.literal: Then at conjunction junctures there ought to be a fixed place—how could it be Dipper or Ox, both standing at one degree?
translations.idiomatic: Then at conjunction junctures there ought to be a fixed place—how could it be Dipper or Ox, both standing at one degree?

sentences.zh: 去極應等，安得南北無常。

translations.literal: Distance from pole ought to be equal—how can north and south be without constant rule?
translations.idiomatic: Distance from pole ought to be equal—how can north and south be without constant rule?

sentences.zh: 若日月非例，則八行之說是衍文邪？

translations.literal: If sun and moon are not the pattern, then is the eight-motion saying derivative text?
translations.idiomatic: If sun and moon are not the pattern, then is the eight-motion saying derivative text?

sentences.zh: 左交右疾，語甚未分，為交與疾對？

translations.literal: Left crossing right fast—the words are very unclear; does crossing pair with fast?
translations.idiomatic: Left crossing right fast—the words are very unclear; does crossing pair with fast?

sentences.zh: 為舍交即疾？

translations.literal: Or abandoning crossing is immediately fast?
translations.idiomatic: Or abandoning crossing is immediately fast?

sentences.zh: 若舍交即疾，即交在平率入曆七日及二十一日是也。

translations.literal: If abandoning crossing is immediately fast, then crossing at mean-rate calendar entry on day seven and day twenty-one is it.
translations.idiomatic: If abandoning crossing is immediately fast, then crossing at mean-rate calendar entry on day seven and day twenty-one is it.

sentences.zh: 值交蝕既當在盈縮之極，豈得損益，或多或少。

translations.literal: When crossing meets eclipse it ought to be at expansion-contraction extremes—how can there be decrease or increase, more or less?
translations.idiomatic: When crossing meets eclipse it ought to be at expansion-contraction extremes—how can there be decrease or increase, more or less?

sentences.zh: 若交與疾對，則在交之沖，當為遲疾之始，豈得入曆或深或淺，倍半相違，新故所同，複摽此句，欲以何明。

translations.literal: If crossing pairs with fast, then at crossing's opposition ought to be slow-fast's beginning—how can calendar entry be deep or shallow, double and half diverging, new and old the same—again marking this line, intending to clarify what?
translations.idiomatic: If crossing pairs with fast, then at crossing's opposition ought to be slow-fast's beginning—how can calendar entry be deep or shallow, double and half diverging, new and old the same—again marking this line, intending to clarify what?

sentences.zh: 臣覽曆書，古今略備，至如此說，所未前聞，遠乖舊准，近背天數，求之愚情，竊所深惑。

translations.literal: I read calendar books ancient and modern, roughly complete—to such a saying I have never heard before; far violating old standard, near betraying celestial numbers—seeking my humble mind, I am deeply confused.
translations.idiomatic: I read calendar books ancient and modern, roughly complete—to such a saying I have never heard before; far violating old standard, near betraying celestial numbers—seeking my humble mind, I am deeply confused.

sentences.zh: 尋遲疾陰陽不相生，故交會加時，進退無常，昔術著之久矣，前儒言之詳矣。

translations.literal: Examining slow-fast yin-yang—they do not generate each other; therefore conjunction added hour advance and retreat have no constant rule; former methods long set it forth, earlier Ru spoke in detail.
translations.idiomatic: Examining slow-fast yin-yang—they do not generate each other; therefore conjunction added hour advance and retreat have no constant rule; former methods long set it forth, earlier Ru spoke in detail.

sentences.zh: 而法興雲日數同。

translations.literal: Yet Faxing says day-counts are the same.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Dai Faxing says day-counts are the same.

sentences.zh: 竊謂議者未曉此意，乖謬自著，無假驟辯，既雲盈縮失衷，複不備記其數，或自嫌所執，故泛略其說乎？

translations.literal: I deem the debater has not understood this meaning—error is self-evident, needing no sudden argument; since he says expansion-contraction misses the mean, again he does not fully record the numbers—or he suspects his own hold, therefore broadly abbreviates the saying?
translations.idiomatic: I deem the debater has not understood this meaning—error is self-evident, needing no sudden argument; since he says expansion-contraction misses the mean, again he does not fully record the numbers—or he suspects his own hold, therefore broadly abbreviates the saying?

sentences.zh: 又以全為率，當互因其分，法興所列二數皆誤，或以八十為七十九，當縮反盈，應損更益，此條之謂矣。

translations.literal: Again taking whole as rate ought mutually to follow their fractions; the two numbers Faxing listed are both wrong—or taking eighty for seventy-nine: where there should be shrinkage there is surplus, where there should be decrease there is increase—this is what this item means.
translations.idiomatic: Again taking whole as rate ought mutually to follow their fractions; the two numbers Dai Faxing listed are both wrong—or taking eighty for seventy-nine: where there should be shrinkage there is surplus, where there should be decrease there is increase—this is what this item means.

sentences.zh: 總檢其議，豈但臣曆不密，又謂何承天法乖謬彌甚。

translations.literal: Summarily examining his objections—not only is my calendar imprecise, he also says He Chengtian's method is even more wrong.
translations.idiomatic: Summarily examining his objections—not only is my calendar imprecise, he also says He Chengtian's method is even more wrong.

sentences.zh: 若臣曆宜棄，則承天術益不可用。

translations.literal: If my calendar ought to be abandoned, then Chengtian's art is even less usable.
translations.idiomatic: If my calendar ought to be abandoned, then Chengtian's art is even less usable.

sentences.zh: 法興所見既審，則應革創。

translations.literal: If Faxing's view is already examined, then reform ought to be undertaken.
translations.idiomatic: If Dai Faxing's view is already examined, then reform ought to be undertaken.

sentences.zh: 至非景極，望非日沖，凡諸新說，必有妙辯乎？

translations.literal: Until non-Jing extreme and full moon non-solar opposition—all new sayings must have clever argument?
translations.idiomatic: Until non-Jing extreme and full moon non-solar opposition—all new sayings must have clever argument?

sentences.zh: 時法興為世祖所寵，天下畏其權，既立異議，論者皆附之。

translations.literal: At the time Faxing was favored by Emperor Shizu; the realm feared his power; having set different objections, debaters all attached to him.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Dai Faxing was favored by Emperor Xiaowu; the realm feared his power; having set different objections, debaters all attached to him.

sentences.zh: 唯中書舍人巢尚之是沖之之術，執據宜用。

translations.literal: Only Palace Secretary Chao Shangzhi approved Chongzhi's art, holding that evidence showed it should be used.
translations.idiomatic: Only Palace Secretary Chao Shangzhi approved Zu Chongzhi's art, holding that evidence showed it should be used.

sentences.zh: 上愛奇慕古，欲用沖之新法，時大明八年也。

translations.literal: The emperor loved the strange and admired antiquity, wishing to use Chongzhi's new method—it was then Daming year 8.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor loved the strange and admired antiquity, wishing to use Zu Chongzhi's new method—it was then Daming year 8.

sentences.zh: 故須明年改元，因此改曆。

translations.literal: Therefore he had to change the era name the next year, and thereby reform the calendar.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore he had to change the era name the next year, and thereby reform the calendar.

sentences.zh: 未及施用，而宮車晏駕也。

translations.literal: Before it could be applied, the imperial carriage passed in peace.
translations.idiomatic: Before it could be applied, the emperor died.
